messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGING: failed to deliver page to on-call (escalation_id=esc_8f4b). 502 from pager-proxy when routing to sms-relay. Investigating.
Alex K: seeing this too, pages not hitting oncall phone. Is this only SMS or all channels?
SRE Bot: noticed spike in 502s from pager-proxy -> notify-bridge between 5067890108-5067890120. Stack traces show upstream blocked connections.
Maria G: @Alex K @Josh P I can take live ops. Quick check: did we just rotate signing keys for pagerflow? Last rotation job completed ~5067889900.
Josh P: I did a small key rotation earlier for pagerflow auth; thought it was a dry-run. Confirming now — rotation succeeded, but webhook verifier saw old key until services restarted.
Tess L: customer-facing alerts: Support reported delayed pages for customer acct-redwood-prod. Can we escalate manually while we fix bot?
Alex K: manual mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback to sms-backup gateway (temp), 2) run one-shot resend script for backlog, 3) notify customers about possible 10-15m delay. Who can flip the fallback?
Josh P: I can flip fallback in notify-bridge, but need approval from oncall. @Tess L please confirm we can do that for prod customers.
Tess L: yep approved — go ahead. Also open a quick support note: "We’re routing pages via alternate gateway while we reconcile webhook keys. No action needed from customers."
SRE Bot: executed toggle: notify-bridge -> sms-backup enabled by Josh P at 5067890132. Backlog length: ~42 pending pages.
Alex K: running resend: ```./tools/resend_pages --escalation esc_8f4b --limit 50``` will replay to sms-backup. Kicking it now.
IncidentBot: INFO: replay job started, id=replay_2026_5067890135. Will post status.
Maria G: root cause summary so far: signing key rotation + staggered service restarts left some webhook verifiers with old key -> pager-proxy 502s -> pages not delivered. Short-term fix: toggle to sms-backup + replay. Mid-term: ensure rotation is atomic or add health-check gating.
Josh P: Postmortem action items: (1) make rotation atomic (feature flag), (2) add test that verifies webhook signature on rotation, (3) add alert when 5xx ratio > 2% for pager-proxy. Adding to backlog.
Tess L: I'll draft customer comms and support note. Any customer impact metrics we can share now?
Alex K: initial: ~42 delayed pages, ~3 customers reported issues. ETA for full catch-up ~5-8 minutes after replay completes.
SRE Bot: replay job completed at 5067890144. All 42 pages delivered via sms-backup. IncidentBot: incident resolved? Recommend short follow-up and retro.
Josh P: switching services to pick up new key now and will restart pager-proxy in a canary first.
Maria G: thanks team — tagging postmortem owner @Josh P. Will run retro tomorrow.
Tess L: :thumbsup: closing loop with support and customers.
